page.overview:
Who is Elephan?

Elephan is one of the many Beastformers who joined White Leo's resistance forces as Galvatron's Decepticons began to conquer the formerly-peaceful planet Beest with their army of cold-blooded insurgents. His role in the Autobot-allied Beastformer forces is a transportation combatant. He also holds the rank of King of Shutoru, in whose eponymous main city he was born, over Emperor Wild Thunder.

Elephan (or possibly "Sledgehammer Elephant" is in the forefront of battle against Megatron and his Air Warriors when they show up on Planet Beest.
